title: Shower Curtain Rod Brackets For 1-Inch Rod (Pair), Solid Brass | Spanish Gold | Shower Curtain Rod Brackets | Allied Brass
body_html:
Finish a bathroom shower curtain rod installation with matching brackets that support the rod and keep the look clean and coordinated in Spanish Gold, which presents a rich, warm golden tone with European-inspired elegance, bringing luxury and sophistication to distinguished bathrooms.

  • Spanish Gold elevates the room with luxe gold tones
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Made for standard rods: Manufactured to be used with any 1-inch diameter shower rod.
  • Coordinated style: Part of the Shower Curtain Rod Brackets collection for transitional bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories.
  • Design flexibility: Offered in multiple designer finish options to match your space.

Specs

  • Product dimensions (L x H x W): 3 in. x 2.25 in. x 3 in.
  • Box dimensions (L x H x W): 6 in. x 6 in. x 6 in.
  • Shipping weight: 2 lbs.
  • Includes: (2) brackets (sold as a pair)
  • Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
  • Assembly: Assembled in the USA
